例句

  1. Most Japanese people spend most of their time working to live.
    大部分日本人把大部分的時間都花在為了生活而工作上。
  2. I spent the whole afternoon washing the car.
    我花了整個下午洗車。
  3. She spends a lot of money buying clothes.
    她花很多錢買衣服。
  4. My brother spends hours playing video games every day.
    我哥哥每天花好幾個小時打電動。
  5. We spent three days traveling around Hokkaido.
    我們花了三天在北海道各地旅行。
  6. How much time do you spend doing your homework?
    你花多少時間寫作業？
  7. My grandmother spends her mornings working in the garden.
    我奶奶每天早上都在院子裡整理花草。
  8. Don't spend all your money eating out.
    不要把你所有的錢都花在外食上。
  9. He spends too much time on video games.
    他花太多時間在電動上。
  10. We spent 3,000 yen on lunch.
    我們午餐花了三千日圓。
  11. I spent most of my money on concert tickets.
    我把大部分的錢花在演唱會門票上。
  12. How much did you spend on your trip to Kyoto?
    你去京都旅行花了多少錢？
  13. My parents spend a lot of money on my education.
    我爸媽在我的教育上花了很多錢。
  14. Ann spent the weekend on her science report.
    Ann 把週末花在她的自然科報告上。
  15. Most people work to live.
    大部分的人為了生活而工作。
  16. My uncle lives to work.
    我舅舅為了工作而活。
  17. Do you work to live or live to work?
    你是為了生活而工作，還是為了工作而活？
  18. Many young people want to work to live, not live to work.
    很多年輕人想為了生活而工作，不想為了工作而活。
  19. I saved money to buy a camera.
    我存錢買相機。
  20. She went to Tokyo to study fashion design.
    她去東京學服裝設計。
  21. Most students spend most of their time studying for exams.
    大部分的學生花大部分的時間準備考試。
  22. My father spends most of his time working, so I rarely see him.
    我爸爸大部分的時間都在工作，所以我很少見到他。
  23. Tom spent two hours waiting for the train.
    Tom 花了兩個小時等火車。
  24. I spend about thirty minutes reading the news every morning.
    我每天早上花大約三十分鐘看新聞。
  25. We spent the evening talking about our school days.
    我們整個晚上都在聊學生時代的事。
  26. She spent all her savings on a trip to Europe.
    她把所有的存款都花在一趟歐洲旅行上。
  27. Taiwanese people spend a lot of money on food.
    台灣人在吃的方面花很多錢。
  28. My mother works part-time to pay for my piano lessons.
    我媽媽打工來付我的鋼琴課學費。
  29. I don't want to spend my life working too hard.
    我不想把我的人生花在拚命工作上。
  30. We went to the station early to get good seats.
    我們為了搶到好位子，提早去車站。
